title: LA passage: ad majorem Dei gloriam
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a la passage.

ad majorem Dei gloriam

Language: la

anchor.prefix:
s before him, went on:

 —He had the faith in him that moves mountains. Ten thousand souls won for God in a single month! That is a true conqueror, true to the motto of our order:
anchor.suffix: ! A saint who has great power in heaven, remember: power to intercede for us in our grief; power to obtain whatever we pray for if it be for the good of our souls; power above all
